description: Replace all slides in the presentation with the supplied complete slide DSL objects. Existing slides and their checkpoints are deleted. This clears the previous generation batch. Read /slides and render every page with has_html=false.

page_no.description: If supplied, must match the 1-based array position.
page_no.title: Page No

operation_id.description: Account-wide operation ID, 1–128 characters after trimming. Reuse only for an identical retry.
operation_id.title: Operation Id

slides.description: All pages in display order. Page numbers are assigned from 1.
slides.title: Slides

name: generate_slides_from_dsl
